answers.core: Bitwise bit manipulation is a feature that makes sense for BitMaps.  Simple things like masking a BitMap will be made a lot easier and more efficient.
answers.workaround:
This could be worked around with a nested double for loop, as I described before.

You can also use the hidden '_get_data' and '_set_data' methods to manually do the optimized operations, but it adds a lot of bulk and I think it is doing an extra copy operation somewhere.
